summary: Nomura Holdings filed a Form 6-K with its consolidated US GAAP results for the first quarter of fiscal year ending March 2027. The filing reports QoQ increases in revenue and income before income taxes, including record income before income taxes across international regions, wealth management record recurring revenue, and investment management record assets under management. The report provides business segment highlights across Wealth Management, Investment Management, Wholesale, and Banking divisions. It also includes financial supplements, balance sheet data, value at risk, and segment-specific details. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation event is described; this is a routine quarterly earnings disclosure.
